Trace, implement and test: 7)Product of Array Except Self

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution:
    def productExceptSelf(self, nums: List[int]) -> List[int]:

        prefix = 1
        prefix_product = []
        for num in nums:
            prefix_product.append(prefix)
            prefix *= num
        
        postfix = 1
        postfix_product = []
        for num in nums[-1::-1]:
            postfix_product.append(postfix)
            postfix *= num
        
        postfix_product.reverse()

        result = []
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            result.append(prefix_product[i] * postfix_product[i])
            
        return result
